compute_jittered_backoff_delay: compute a jittered exponential backoff delay for a given retry attempt number
calculate_backoff_with_custom_base_delay: calculate jittered backoff delay using a custom base delay of 10 seconds
set_max_delay_cap_for_backoff: set a maximum delay cap of 60 seconds on the jittered backoff calculation
apply_jitter_ratio_to_backoff: apply a 0.25 jitter ratio to reduce random variation in backoff delays
use_backoff_for_rate_limited_retries: use jittered backoff to decorrelate concurrent retries when hitting rate-limited providers
